mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkin (appointment_id, patient_id, department_id, doctor_id, checkin_time, queue_status, call_time, call_count, rejoin_time, consult_room, create_time) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{patientId}, #{departmentId}, #{doctorId}, #{checkinTime}, #{queueStatus}, #{callTime}, #{callCount}, #{rejoinTime}, #{consultRoom}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM checkin WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY create_time DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM checkin WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND queue_status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY checkin_time ASC
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id AS checkin_id, c.appointment_id, c.patient_id, c.department_id, dep.dept_name AS department_name, c.doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, a.appointment_date, a.period, a.slot_seq, s.slot_start, s.slot_end, c.queue_status, c.call_count, c.consult_room, a.visit_status, c.checkin_time, c.call_time FROM checkin c LEFT JOIN appointment a ON c.appointment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN department dep ON c.department_id = dep.id LEFT JOIN slot s ON a.slot_id = s.id
mapper.select: WHERE c.department_id = #{departmentId} AND c.queue_status IN ('CALLED', 'RE_CALLED', 'IN_CONSULT') ORDER BY c.call_time DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE checkin SET queue_status = #{queueStatus}, rejoin_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
